codegen_datasources.list.title: List code generation data sources
codegen_datasources.list.description: Page through the external data sources used by code generation; filter by database type and status, search by name, description, host and database name.
codegen_datasources.options.title: List code generation data source options
codegen_datasources.options.description: List every data source, disabled ones included, ordered by sort number and name, for drop-downs.
codegen_datasources.get.title: Get a code generation data source
codegen_datasources.get.description: Get a data source with its account and connection settings; the password and the connection string are never returned, only whether an explicit connection string is set.
codegen_datasources.create.title: Create a code generation data source
codegen_datasources.create.description: Create an external data source: the name is unique, the password and the explicit connection string are stored encrypted, and making it the default clears the others.
codegen_datasources.update.title: Update a code generation data source
codegen_datasources.update.description: Update a data source; leave the password or the connection string empty to keep it, and send back the concurrency stamp you read. The cached connection is dropped and rebuilt on next use.
codegen_datasources.set_status.title: Enable or disable a code generation data source
codegen_datasources.set_status.descripti: Enable or disable a data source; disabled sources cannot be used to read schemas or query data. Send back the concurrency stamp you read; a remark, when given, replaces the current one.
codegen_datasources.delete.title: Delete code generation data sources
codegen_datasources.delete.description: Delete data sources in a batch; sources still referenced by a table configuration are refused one by one.
codegen_datasources.test_connection.titl: Test a code generation data source connection
codegen_datasources.test_connection.desc: Open and close one temporary connection with the current settings (disabled sources too) and record the time, result and message of this test; a failed connection is reported in the result, not as an error.
codegeneration.datasource.name_taken: A data source named '{name}' already exists.
codegeneration.datasource.in_use: The data source is still referenced by a table configuration.
codegeneration.datasource.disabled: Data source '{name}' is disabled and cannot be used to read schemas or query data.
codegeneration.datasource.secret_unreada: The password or connection string of data source '{name}' cannot be decrypted; the data protection keys may have changed. Enter them again.
openapi.groups.codegeneration.name: Code generation
openapi.groups.codegeneration.descriptio: Data sources, table and column configurations, templates, generation history and the read-only no-code runtime of the platform.
openapi.tags.codegen_datasources.name: Code generation data sources
openapi.tags.codegen_datasources.descrip: External databases to import table schemas from and to query in the no-code runtime; credentials are stored encrypted.
permissions.codegeneration.codegen_datas: View the external data sources used to import table schemas; passwords and connection strings are never returned.
Create external data sources; the password and the connection string are stored encrypted.
Edit, enable or disable data sources and test their connections.
Delete data sources that no table configuration references.
permissions.codegeneration.codegen_table: Open the code generation page, view the imported table configurations and list the tables of a database.
codegen_tables.list.title: List code generation tables
codegen_tables.list.description: Page through the imported table configurations; filter by template type, delivery, generation result and status, search by table name, class name and comment.
codegen_tables.options.title: List code generation table options
codegen_tables.options.description: List every table configuration ordered by table name, to pick master tables and related tables.
codegen_tables.get.title: Get a code generation table
codegen_tables.get.description: Get a table configuration with its column configurations.
codegen_tables.db_tables.title: List database tables
codegen_tables.db_tables.description: Page through the tables of the primary database or of an enabled data source to import; the keyword matches names and comments, and sharded tables are folded into one logical name.
codegen_tables.import.title: Import database tables
codegen_tables.import.description: Import tables as table configurations, inferring class names, types, controls and query modes from the schema; each table succeeds or fails on its own (already imported, missing or without columns).
codegen_tables.sync_schema.title: Synchronize a table with its schema
codegen_tables.sync_schema.description: Re-read the schema of the table: structural fields follow the database, inferred fields follow the new inference unless edited by hand, new columns are added and dropped columns are removed.
codegen_tables.update.title: Update a code generation table
codegen_tables.update.description: Update a table configuration as a whole; the template type cannot be universal and importing needs creating. Fields changed here are kept when the schema is synchronized. Send back the concurrency stamp you read.
codegen_tables.set_status.title: Enable or disable a code generation table
codegen_tables.set_status.description: Enable or disable a table configuration; disabled tables cannot be browsed in the no-code runtime. Send back the concurrency stamp you read; a remark, when given, replaces the current one.
codegen_tables.delete.title: Delete code generation tables
codegen_tables.delete.description: Delete table configurations in a batch together with their column configurations.
codegen_table_columns.list.title: List code generation columns
codegen_table_columns.list.description: List the column configurations of a table, ordered by sort number.
codegen_table_columns.save.title: Save code generation columns
codegen_table_columns.save.description: Save the column configurations of a table at once: every column must belong to the table, an option source keeps only the setting it needs, and fields changed here are kept when the schema is synchronized. Send back each concurrency stamp you read.
codegeneration.table.no_column: Table '{table}' has no columns and cannot be imported.
codegeneration.table.template_type_unive: A table configuration must be single, tree or master-detail; universal is for templates only.
codegeneration.table.actions_conflict: Importing creates rows one by one: select Create together with Import.
codegeneration.column.not_in_table: A column configuration does not belong to this table. Reload and try again.
codegeneration.column.selector_dict_code: Column '{column}': a system dictionary needs a dictionary code.
codegeneration.column.selector_enum_requ: Column '{column}': an enum needs the full type name.
codegeneration.column.selector_const_inv: Column '{column}': constant options must be valid JSON.
codegeneration.column.selector_relation_: Column '{column}': a relation needs the related table.
codegeneration.column.selector_label_req: Column '{column}': a related table needs the display column.
codegeneration.database.unsupported: The primary database type '{type}' is not supported by code generation.
openapi.tags.codegen_tables.name: Code generation tables
openapi.tags.codegen_tables.description: Table configurations imported from database schemas: listing, import, schema synchronization, editing and deletion.
openapi.tags.codegen_table_columns.name: Code generation columns
openapi.tags.codegen_table_columns.descr: Column configurations of a table: types, form controls, query modes and option sources.
permissions.codegeneration.codegen_table: Edit, enable or disable table configurations.
Delete table configurations together with their column configurations.
Import database tables as table configurations and synchronize them with the latest schema.
View the column configurations of a table.
Save the column configurations of a table.
codegen_tables.preview.title: Preview generated code
codegen_tables.preview.description: Render the templates for a table configuration and return every file without packaging or recording history; also returns the localization files of a new package and the registration notes.
codegen_templates.list.title: List code generation templates
codegen_templates.list.description: Page through the templates without their bodies; filter by group, template type, write mode, status and built-in flag, search by code, name and description.
codegen_templates.get.title: Get a code generation template
codegen_templates.get.description: Get a template with its body and path expressions.
codegen_templates.validate.title: Check template syntax
codegen_templates.validate.description: Parse a template body without rendering it and return the syntax errors with line and column.
codegen_templates.create.title: Create a code generation template
codegen_templates.create.description: Create a custom template; the code must be unique and cannot be changed later.
codegen_templates.update.title: Update a code generation template
codegen_templates.update.description: Update a custom template; built-in templates follow the application version and cannot be edited.
codegen_templates.set_status.title: Enable or disable a code generation template
codegen_templates.set_status.description: Enable or disable a template, built-in ones included; disabled templates are skipped when generating.
codegen_templates.delete.title: Delete code generation templates
codegen_templates.delete.description: Delete custom templates in batch; built-in templates are rejected item by item.
codegeneration.template.built_in: Built-in template '{code}' cannot be edited or deleted; create a custom template instead.
codegeneration.generate.class_mismatch: Table '{table}' already has entity '{entity}'; the generated code reuses it, so set the class name to '{expected}'.
codegeneration.generate.module_invalid: Package name '{module}' must start with a letter and contain only letters and digits.
codegeneration.generate.namespace_invali: Namespace '{namespace}' is not a valid C# namespace.
codegeneration.generate.dict_code_missin: Column '{column}' uses a dictionary but has no dictionary code.
codegeneration.generate.dict_not_string: Column '{column}' uses a dictionary but its type is {type}; dictionary items are stored by code, so the column must be text.
codegeneration.generate.enum_unresolved: Column '{column}' uses enum '{enum}', which cannot be resolved or is not the column's C# type: resync the table schema or fix the enum type name.
codegeneration.generate.relation_not_gui: Column '{column}' is a relation but its type is {type}; it stores the related record's ID and must be Guid.
codegeneration.generate.relation_target_: Column '{column}' is a relation but its related table is not set or no longer exists.
codegeneration.generate.relation_tree_in: Column '{column}' is a tree relation but '{target}' is not a tree table with a Guid parent column.
codegeneration.generate.relation_label_i: The display column '{label}' of relation column '{column}' is not set, not in the related table, or not text.
codegeneration.generate.unique_unsupport: Column '{column}' is marked unique but its type {type} cannot be checked for uniqueness.
codegeneration.generate.status_missing: Table '{table}' has the status toggle enabled but no column uses an enum with Active and Disabled. For a new entity an integer column named Status with no enum also works; the generator then emits the enum.
codegeneration.generate.status_ambiguous: Several columns use an enum with Active and Disabled ({columns}); name the status property Status.
codegeneration.generate.status_not_liste: Status column '{column}' must be shown in the list: the row toggle switches by the listed value.
codegeneration.generate.tree_parent_inva: Tree table '{table}': the parent column '{column}' is not set, not in the column configuration, or not Guid.
codegeneration.generate.tree_name_invali: Tree table '{table}': the name column '{column}' is not set, not in the column configuration, or not shown in the list.
codegeneration.generate.master_invalid: Master-detail table '{table}': the master table or the foreign key column to it is not set correctly.
codegeneration.generate.no_templates: No enabled template applies (check the template types, status and the generation scope).
codegeneration.generate.path_invalid: Template '{template}' produced the path '{path}', which leaves its root folder.
codegeneration.generate.const_options_mi: Column '{column}' uses constant options but has none.
codegeneration.generate.const_options_in: The constant options of column '{column}' must be a non-empty array of objects, each with a text label and a text or number value: {value}
codegeneration.generate.const_options_ty: Column '{column}' is {type} but its constant option values are {valueType}.
openapi.tags.codegen_templates.name: Code generation templates
openapi.tags.codegen_templates.descripti: Scriban templates that turn table configurations into a backend package and frontend module: built-in templates follow the application version, custom ones can be added.
permissions.codegeneration.codegen_templ: View the code generation templates and check their syntax.
Edit custom templates and enable or disable any template; built-in templates cannot be edited.
Delete custom templates; built-in templates cannot be deleted.
codegen_tables.generate.title: Generate code
codegen_tables.generate.description: Generate the code of a table configuration: as a package kept as a 7-day temporary file and downloaded from the history, or written into the project in development (write-once files that already exist are skipped); every run is recorded in the history.
codegen_histories.list.title: List code generation history
codegen_histories.list.description: List the code generation history with paging; the keyword matches the table name and batch number, and results can be filtered by table, outcome, delivery and generation time.
codegen_histories.get.title: Get code generation history
codegen_histories.get.description: Get one history entry with the generated files, the templates used, the table configuration snapshot and the failure reason.
openapi.tags.codegen_histories.name: Code generation history
openapi.tags.codegen_histories.descripti: A record of every generation run: outcome, files, templates and the package download.
permissions.codegeneration.codegen_table: Generate the code of a table configuration as a downloadable package, or write it into the project in development.
permissions.codegeneration.codegen_histo: View the code generation history and download the generated packages.
codegeneration.history.package_not_found: History entry '{table}' has no package: it was written into the project, the run failed, or the package expired after 7 days.
codegeneration.project.disabled: Writing into the project is only available in development with BasicApp:CodeGeneration:EnableGenerateToProject turned on; download the package elsewhere.
codegeneration.project.backend_root_inva: {path} ({key}) is not a backend root: it must contain src/.
codegeneration.project.frontend_root_inv: {path} ({key}) is not a frontend root: it must contain package.json.
codegeneration.project.package_missing: Adding to an existing package needs {project} in the project ({path}): create the package first or choose a new package.
codegeneration.project.path_outside: Artifact path {path} falls outside its root directory.
codegeneration.project.foreign_manual: {path} already exists in the project but was not produced by the generator (there is no matching {generated}): writing would define it twice. Move the hand-written file away first, then generate.
codegen_runtime.get_schema.title: Get zero-code runtime schema
codegen_runtime.get_schema.description: The columns of an enabled table configuration: column name, the key in the data rows, display name and control.
codegen_runtime.list.title: List zero-code runtime data
codegen_runtime.list.description: Read the data of an enabled table configuration page by page from its data source, up to 500 rows per page, without generating any code.
openapi.tags.codegen_runtime.name: Zero-code runtime
openapi.tags.codegen_runtime.description: Read the data of a configured table read-only, without generating code.
permissions.codegeneration.codegen_runti: View the data of an enabled table configuration read-only, without generating any code.
codegeneration.runtime.table_disabled: Table configuration '{name}' is disabled and cannot be opened in the zero-code runtime.
codegeneration.runtime.read_failed: Could not read the data of table '{table}': {reason}
codegeneration.runtime.table_reserved: "{table}" belongs to the application itself. The zero-code runtime does not read it.
codegeneration.datasource.secret_require: Enter the secret again after changing the connection address: the old secret is not sent to a new address.
codegeneration.datasource.sqlite_disable: SQLite data sources are not enabled (BasicApp:CodeGeneration:AllowSqliteDataSource).
codegeneration.datasource.target_denied: The outbound address policy does not allow connecting to {host}. Allow internal databases under XiHan:Security:Outbound.
codegeneration.table.rename_rejected: The table name of a configuration cannot be changed. Import the other table instead.
